title: Prayer Times and Qibla
description: Prayer Times App is for all Muslims who want to know accurate Prayer timings. You can set and customize reminder notifications for each prayer time. Main features: • Shows the times for Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha, and optional times like Imsak, Shuruq, Duha, Midnight and Qiyam • Several methods of calculation or importing your timetable CSV file • Customize reminder notifications settings for each prayer time • Reminder before entering Times • Qibla compass • Islamic Hijri calendar • Personal reminder at a specified time before/after prayer time • Shows the nearest Masjid to your location • Many adhan voices available to download • Automatically change to Do Not Disturb in time of prayer • Display prayer times on widgets or the Notification Bar • Change app color themes • Companion app for Wear OS is available, with complication data • etc Support development by upgrading to Pro and unlocking extra features: • Play Adhan randomly from your collections • Customize themes • Wear OS Tile • And more We welcome suggestions, recommendations, or if you want to help us translate the app to your language.
descriptionHTML:
Prayer Times App is for all Muslims who want to know accurate Prayer timings. You can set and customize reminder notifications for each prayer time.

Main features:
• Shows the times for Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha, and optional times like Imsak, Shuruq, Duha, Midnight and Qiyam
• Several methods of calculation or importing your timetable CSV file
• Customize reminder notifications settings for each prayer time
• Reminder before entering Times
• Qibla compass
• Islamic Hijri calendar
• Personal reminder at a specified time before/after prayer time
• Shows the nearest Masjid to your location
• Many adhan voices available to download
• Automatically change to Do Not Disturb in time of prayer
• Display prayer times on widgets or the Notification Bar
• Change app color themes
• Companion app for Wear OS is available, with complication data
• etc

Support development by upgrading to Pro and unlocking extra features:
• Play Adhan randomly from your collections
• Customize themes
• Wear OS Tile
• And more

We welcome suggestions, recommendations, or if you want to help us translate the app to your language.
